`tax_for` in `src/billing/tax.py` now rounds half-up. I haven't run it or any tests.

The function was a `NotImplementedError` stub, so there was no existing rounding to change. I implemented it as `amount_cents * rate`, quantized to whole cents with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, and it returns an `int`. The rate is converted with `Decimal(str(rate))`, so a float rate doesn't pick up binary-float error. I assumed that rate format, so check it matches what callers pass.

An EngramDB memory recorded the March 2026 decision to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` and said not to use half-up. I flagged it as challenged using your statement as evidence. I then saved a new decision for half-up that supersedes it.
